name: open-bridge
description: Standalone Streamable HTTP MCP bridge for local workspaces. 在本机安全暴露工作区能力的独立 MCP 桥接（CLI + Web 控制台）。
author: aoliaoduo <aoliaoduo@126.com>

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:core: tsx --test test/*.test.ts && node --test test/api-integration.test.mjs test/api-teardown-integration.test.mjs test/tunnel-integration.test.mjs test/guards-integration.test.mjs test/mcp-protocol-integration.test.mjs test/mcp-modern-protocol-integration.test.mjs test/oauth-integration.test.mjs test/multi-instance-integration.test.mjs test/crash-guards-integration.test.mjs test/stop-guard-integration.test.mjs test/skills-integration.test.mjs test/clean-scope.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
